item.title: Parents’ Academic Day
item.excerpt: Parents are invited to meet teachers, review progress and discuss learners’ academic plans.
item.body:
Parents are invited to meet teachers, review progress and discuss learners’ academic plans.

The school community continues to demonstrate its commitment to excellence. We thank our learners, staff and parents for their continued support.

More details will be shared through official school communication channels.
